Daigle will retire as Chief Executive Officer on August 13, 2026, while remaining on the Board as Executive Chairman. The company appointed current President and COO Guy Shechter as the new CEO effective the same date. Daigle’s transition agreement includes a $300,000 annual base salary and a grant of 50,000 RSUs vesting over two years. Shechter received a grant of 25,000 RSUs vesting ratably over three years. The leadership change is not due to any disagreement regarding operations or policies. Amtech Systems operates in the semiconductor equipment industry, providing manufacturing solutions for advanced packaging and display technologies.
